# performance-methodology

Baseline-first performance work - measured baseline before claims, thresholds declared, benchmarks answer questions.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-PERF-001` | high | Every list response carries a server-side bound |
| `AF-PERF-003` | medium | Conditional requests serve cache before compute |
| `AF-PERF-004` | low | Compression is negotiated, not assumed |
| `AF-PERF-005` | high | Timeouts exist before retries, and retries carry jitter |
| `AF-PERF-006` | medium | A performance claim requires a measured baseline |
| `AF-PERF-007` | medium | Sync work does not block the request path unnecessarily |
